paragraphs.text: Khazi was a planeswalker who perished on Ravnica during the War of the Spark , one of many who fell victim to Nicol Bolas 's invasion.

Khazi was among the many planeswalkers drawn to Ravnica by the activation of the Interplanar Beacon , which served as a trap when Nicol Bolas used the Immortal Sun to prevent any planeswalker from leaving the plane. Once stranded, Khazi fought alongside other planeswalkers and the native guilds of Ravnica against the invading Dreadhorde —an endless army of Eternals reanimated from the corpses of Amonkhet 's fallen.

During the siege, Khazi joined forces with Ajani Goldmane , Huatli , Jiang Yanggu , and Mu Yanling to help protect and evacuate Ravnican civilians amid the chaos. The group took shelter inside an old chapel but was quickly surrounded by multiple crops of the Dreadhorde. Despite their best efforts to hold the position, an Eternal broke through the chapel wall and harvested Khazi's spark by force, killing her in the process.
